name: Meteoric-Barrow
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around massive canyon systems, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on copper, titanium and uranium are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
